description: Paid (x402: USDC on Base, USDC on Solana, XRP on XRPL, USDC on Arc, or XAH on Xahau). Map a model's raw probability to an empirically calibrated one using resolved outcomes on the ledger. Refuses with insufficient_data below 30 samples.

model.description: Model identifier whose resolved ledger predictions define the calibration mapping (e.g. 'jev-1.14.0'). The model needs at least 30 resolved predictions or the call refuses with insufficient_data.

prob.description: The model's raw predicted probability to recalibrate, between 0 and 1.

task_type.description: Optional task category filter; omit to fit the mapping on all of the model's resolved predictions.

name: court_recalibrate
title: Recalibrate a Model Probability
